title: Bioinformatics approach reveals the modulatory role of JUN in atorvastatin-mediated anti-breast cancer effects.
authors: Foda, Mohamed Y; Al-Shun, Sara A; Abdelkrim, Guendouzi; Salem, Mohamed L; Salah, Nevin A; El-Khawaga, Omali Y
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析阿托伐他汀在乳腺癌中调控JUN基因表达，并初步预测药物与JUN蛋白的直接结合，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Atorvastatin, a widely prescribed cholesterol-lowering drug, has recently shown potential anticancer effects. However, its influence on gene expression and its biological functions in cancer, in particular breast cancer, still unclear. We aim to identify the dysregulated genes associated with atorvastatin treatment and the main players in their biological network. A total of 103 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in the unified signature were identified, and the functional enrichment analysis suggested their relation to multiple cancer-related pathways. JUN was identified as the hub gene in the protein-protein interaction (PPI) network and was shown to be responsive to atorvastatin in breast cancer. Atorvastatin exhibited notable predicted cytotoxicity against breast cancer lines, with the activity positively correlated with JUN expression. JUN was significantly downregulated in breast cancer expression inversely correlated with cancer progression, whereas higher JUN expression was linked with better survival outcomes. Atorvastatin may directly interact with JUN protein forming a more compact and stable conformation. These findings demystify the potential therapeutic mechanism of atorvastatin in breast cancer, possibly by fine tuning of JUN expression. As such, JUN might serve as a valuable prognostic biomarker in breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 阿托伐他汀（Atorvastatin）是一种广泛处方的降胆固醇药物，近期显示出潜在的抗癌作用。然而，其对基因表达的影响及其在癌症（尤其是乳腺癌）中的生物学功能仍不清楚。我们旨在识别与阿托伐他汀治疗相关的失调基因及其生物学网络中的主要参与者。在统一特征中共鉴定出103个差异表达基因（DEGs），功能富集分析表明它们与多种癌症相关通路有关。JUN被确定为蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络中的枢纽基因，并显示在乳腺癌中对阿托伐他汀有响应。阿托伐他汀对乳腺癌细胞系表现出显著的预测细胞毒性，其活性与JUN表达正相关。JUN在乳腺癌中显著下调，其表达与癌症进展呈负相关，而较高的JUN表达与更好的生存结果相关。阿托伐他汀可能直接与JUN蛋白相互作用，形成更紧凑且稳定的构象。这些发现揭示了阿托伐他汀在乳腺癌中的潜在治疗机制，可能通过精细调控JUN表达实现。因此，JUN可能作为乳腺癌中有价值的预后生物标志物。
